description: Look up the archived/historical version of a web page in the Internet Archive Wayback Machine. Returns the closest available snapshot (its Wayback URL, timestamp and HTTP status). Pass a timestamp to find the snapshot nearest a specific date; omit it to get the latest archived version.

timestamp.description: Optional target date as YYYYMMDD or YYYYMMDDhhmmss. The closest snapshot to this time is returned. Defaults to the latest snapshot.

url.description: The page URL to look up, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com/page".

name: get_snapshot
